summary: Iter22: Tested new paywall upgrade packs (lectures_upgrade ₹1,500 and lectures_tests_upgrade ₹2,500). All 6 backend tests passed and full frontend flow verified. Server-side price catalog is enforced, /auth/me exposes access_tier + is_existing_student, /upgrade page renders both plan cards with correct testids, Razorpay checkout opens with correct plan payload, and Upgrade CTA/nav are correctly hidden for admin role.

backend.test_create_order_price_override_for_upg: PASS - client amount=1 ignored, server returned 150000

frontend.student_dashboard_upgrade_cta: PASS - data-testid=upgrade-cta-btn visible after auth loaded
frontend.razorpay_checkout_opens: PASS - window.Razorpay loaded, api.razorpay.com iframe attached, /payments/create-order XHR body={"plan":"lectures_upgrade"}
frontend.admin_upgrade_hidden: PASS - upgrade-cta-btn and nav-upgrade both absent for admin@nexuacademy.com

critical_code_review_comments: payment_routes.py verify() and webhook() duplicate the tier promotion logic (two different CASE expressions). Consider extracting into a single helper to avoid drift between the two paths.

UpgradePage.grantedRank mapping hard-codes plan→tier relationship — this duplicates PLAN_CATALOG server-side knowledge in the frontend. Consider exposing plan metadata via an endpoint for a single source of truth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter22 paywall packs fully verified. Real Razorpay checkout was NOT completed (per instructions). Tier promotion on successful verify was not exercised end-to-end (needs real payment). If future iteration must test tier promotion, mock/patch verify signature or use test razorpay webhook simulator.
